page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6v-c10g1.20xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 82 dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 vCPUs running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 336.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 4.1 GB of RAM per core.

For parallel processing workloads, the instance integrates eight NVIDIA V100 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 128 GB of VRAM. This server does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 35 Gbps.

Given the density of its eight dedicated GPUs and high vCPU count, this instance represents a high-end hardware profile optimized for resource-intensive parallel computing. It is designed for workloads such as deep learning training, complex scientific simulations, high-performance computing, and large-scale parallel data processing.
